description: What the application's own pages may call. app-commands is every command the application registers (generated by build.rs from src/lib.rs); it is granted here, to local pages only, so that no other origin - including a page embedded in an iframe - can call them. The plugin permissions are only the ones the frontend actually uses: opener.openUrl, updater.check, process.relaunch, dialog.ask, and fs.readFile inside $APPDATA/recordings. Autostart, global shortcuts and the settings store are driven from Rust through plugin APIs, which need no capability - listing them here would only widen what a script running inside the webview could reach. Grant a plugin permission here only when a src/ import needs it. Never add a remote section: build.rs refuses it.
